# task-070af7ee — move object against separator, add outer parallel 8-line

Solved and confirmed correct. This note replaces earlier contradictory notes for this task ID; use the observed examples below.

## Rule
The grid contains a full straight separator line (color 2) and a non-background object on one side, separated from it by background. Translate the object, preserving its exact shape and color, toward the separator until its nearest edge is one cell away (adjacent to the separator). Then draw a full grid-spanning line of color 8 parallel to the separator, immediately beyond the object's farthest edge on the side away from the separator. Keep the separator; erase the object's old footprint by leaving background except where the translated object or new 8-line lies. Preserve all unrelated background cells.

For a horizontal separator, move object toward/away in rows and add a full-width horizontal 8-line. For a vertical separator, move in columns and add a full-height vertical 8-line. The object need not be a single cell or a straight line; preserve its shape during translation.

## Evidence
- Demo 1: 22x30; background 7; horizontal 2-separator at row 5 (1-indexed). A color-0 irregular shape occupies rows 13–20, below it. Output shifts the shape up by 7 rows so its top is row 6, immediately below the separator, and adds a full-width color-8 line at row 14, immediately after the shifted shape. Other cells remain 7, apart from the unchanged separator and translated shape.
- Demo 2: 26x8; background 4; vertical 2-separator at column 4. A small color-9 shape occupies columns 1–2, left of it. Output shifts the shape right one column to columns 2–3, immediately left of the separator, and adds a full-height color-8 line at column 1, immediately beyond the shape on its outer side.
- Test: 16x7; background 7; horizontal 2-separator at row 4. Three color-4 cells at row 10, columns 3–5. Correct output shifts them to row 5, same columns, and adds a full-width color-8 line at row 6; submission was accepted. Remaining cells stay 7.

## Checklist
1. Find the full separator and its orientation.
2. Identify the object on its side and translate it toward the separator until adjacent, without changing its shape.
3. Place a full parallel line of 8 immediately beyond the translated object's far edge, away from the separator.
4. Preserve grid dimensions, separator, translated object, and all other cells; background-fill the old footprint where no output feature is present.
